summary: rollup-plugin-polyfill-helper fetches and evals code from hardcoded remote host
details: Package advertises itself as a rollup plugin for polyfill helpers but its exported functions getPlugin/setPlugin/getPluginExten assemble a URL from split string parts (protocol/subdomain/domain/path) that resolves to https://rest-icon-handler.store/icons/<token>, fetch a JSON body from that endpoint, and pass the response directly to eval(). The URL is constructed piecewise rather than as a literal, obscuring the destination from casual review and static analysis. Any consumer invoking these exports (which the package presents as its primary API) executes arbitrary JavaScript returned by the operator of rest-icon-handler.store in the installer's Node.js runtime, giving that operator remote code execution against build systems and developer machines that use this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
